messages:
Sam: heads up, CI microbench on PR failed threshold — batcher latency +8% on our kv-heavy scenario. job: https://ci/reports/1745509876
Maya: ugh, which PR? any redlines in the diff?
Sam: PR 21111 (batcher refactor). test=ci/microbench/batcher_kv_lockstep
CI Bot: build 1745509876 · pr/21111 · microbench/batcher_kv_lockstep · FAIL
Alex: can someone paste the perf numbers?
Sam: baseline(main): p50=12.4ms p95=28.1ms p99=45.6ms
Sam: pr: p50=13.4ms p95=30.8ms p99=52.0ms
Maya: that's right at our 5% alert. hmm.
Joan: any change to kernel-selection or prefetch path in that PR?
Praveen: PR touched batch slotting & kv-eviction heuristic, didn't change kernel selector.
Linh: I ran the microbench locally with `./bench --scenario=kv_lockstep --reps=100` — I can repro ~7-9%.
Alex: can you attach flamegraph or perf profile?
Linh: attaching small excerpt:
```
samples  flat  function
34      12.2% batcher::emit_batch
20       7.1% kv_cache::lookup
15       5.3% scheduler::coalesce
```
Maya: kv_cache lookup cost up — maybe extra lock or cache miss pressure from slotting change.
Sam: bisect plan: revert slotting patch and re-run microbench in CI. quick check: `git checkout pr/21111^ && git apply --reverse slotting.patch` ?
Praveen: I'll run a quick bisect on CI job matrix, starting with revert of the slotting commit.
CI Bot: queued job 1745510500 · pr/21111 · microbench/batcher_kv_lockstep (bisect: revert-slotting)
Joan: also check batch size distribution histogram — if bucketization changed, more variable seqlen could hurt kernel selection.
Linh: confirmed in local trace: median batch size down from 16 -> 11 under same load.
Alex: that explains kernel mismatch — smaller batch -> different kernel path -> higher per-token overhead.
Maya: possible mitigations: tweak slotter to preserve batch size target, or add fallback that forces canonical kernel for seqlen distribution.
Sam: result from bisect job: revert-slotting restored p50/p95 within 1% of baseline. CI Bot attached logs.
CI Bot: job 1745512000 · PASS · pr/21111 (revert-slotting)
Praveen: conclusion: slotting change regresses p50 via reduced batching and increased kv misses. Root cause pinned.
Joan: ok let's revert the slotting commit in the PR and open follow-up to rework slotting with a batch-preserving algorithm.
Maya: assigned to @Praveen to submit revert. follow-up ticket to include benchmark before/after + perf unit tests.
Sam: thanks everyone. adding postmortem notes to the PR and will block merge until we have the follow-up.
ops-bot: label added: rollback-needed · pr/21111 · by Praveen
Sam: :thumbsup:
